vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Numbers come from web-search results of the cited pages (mostly UK eBay listings, many from breakers); catalogue sites and dealer stores could not be opened from the research session. Many VAG parts carry several suffix revisions by build date and equipment, so lamps, cooling parts and wheels are offered as variants only. Verify every number against the VIN before ordering. Sides: LH = the vehicle's own left (UK nearside / passenger side); RH = the vehicle's own right (UK offside / driver side).
